title: Optimal Energy-Norm Convergence for the Dynamic Diffusion Finite Element Method
summary: We revisit the nonlinear two-scale Dynamic Diffusion (DD) finite element formulation mathematically analyzed by Santos et al. (2021) for stationary advection--diffusion--reaction problems. We establish an explicit local Lipschitz estimate for the artificial diffusivity, with a constant of order $h_T$, and use it to prove uniqueness of the discrete solution for sufficiently fine meshes.
